description: Retrieve the wallet's recent on-chain transaction history from event logs, plus process-lifetime x402_pay settlements (tx hash, payee, amount, token, URL, replay count). Shows executions, queued transactions, approvals, cancellations, spend policy updates, and operator changes. Filter by event type or block range for targeted queries. x402 settlement rows appear when event_type is all.

from_block.description: Start block (decimal string). Defaults to 1000 blocks ago.

limit.description: Max entries per source (on-chain events and x402 receipts each; default: 20, max: 100)

to_block.description: End block (decimal string). Defaults to latest.

name: get_transaction_history
